camel_example: aliyun smc CreateCrossZoneMigrationJob --region cn-hangzhou --Disk.1.PerformanceLevel PL0 --Disk.1.DiskId 'd-bp1eeplkn4j29wf70000' --TargetZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-i' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmw3ty5y70000' --InstanceId 'i-bp1ff25rzvnul6kr0000' --Disk.1.Category cloud_essd --TargetVSwitchId 'vsw-bp1mxqnssl8nafltc0000' --TargetInstanceType 'ecs.g7.large' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AutoPay false --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000'
description_en: Server Migration Center (SMC) lets you migrate an Alibaba Cloud Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance to a different zone within the same region and change its instance type, including the vCPU and memory, within the same instance family. This feature helps you meet business requirements for instance migration and specification changes. Call this operation to create a cross-zone migration job
description_zh: SMC支持将阿里云云服务器ECS迁移到同地域的不同可用区，同时也支持在同规格族内更改实例规格（vCPU和内存），满足您迁移云服务器ECS和变配实例规格的业务需求。您可以通过此接口创建跨可用区任务
kebab_example: aliyun smc create-cross-zone-migration-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --instance-id i-bp1ff25rzvnul6kr0000 --target-vswitch-id vsw-bp1mxqnssl8nafltc0000 --target-zone-id cn-hangzhou-i --target-instance-type ecs.g7.large --auto-pay false --disk Category=cloud_essd PerformanceLevel=PL0 DiskId=d-bp1eeplkn4j29wf70000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmw3ty5y70000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCrossZoneMigrationJob

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination Alibaba Cloud region.

For example, if you want to migrate a source server to the China (Hangzhou) region, the region ID is `cn-hangzhou`. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
迁移源要迁入的目标阿里云地域ID。

例如，您需要迁移源服务器至杭州，则相应的阿里云地域ID为`cn-hangzhou`。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. \`ClientToken\` can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination vSwitch
parameters.name: target_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination zone
parameters.name: target_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: (Default) Enables automatic payment. Make sure that your account has a sufficient balance.

false: Disables automatic payment. In this case, you must manually complete the payment. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85052.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费，取值说明：

true：（默认值）自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。
false：手动付费。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85052.html
parameters.name: auto_pay

fields.help_en: The disk category. \`cloud\_essd\` indicates an Enhanced SSD (ESSD)
fields.name: category

fields.help_en:
The performance level of the ESSD. Valid values:

PL0: A single disk can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.

PL1: A single disk can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.

PL2: A single disk can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.

PL3: A single disk can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS
fields.help_zh:
ESSD云盘的性能等级。取值范围：

PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万。
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万。
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万。
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万
fields.name: performance_level
